items.defectStatement: validateUploadedFile uses a fixed 10 MB limit instead of the configured limit for the upload type. This rejects uploads allowed by higher site settings and lets uploads exceeding lower settings pass client validation.
obligations: Select max_image_size_kb or max_attachment_size_kb according to type.
Reject files strictly exceeding the configured limit, comparing sizes in KB.
Display the applicable configured limit in the existing error message.
items.notes: The separate hardcoded limit in the HTTP 413 handler is outside this finding.

items.defectStatement: In app/models/optimized_image.rb, the second self.downsize definition replaces the width/height version. ResizeEmoji still calls downsize(path, path, 100, 100, opts), so its five-argument invocation raises ArgumentError.
obligations: Make ResizeEmoji's downsizing invocation compatible with the effective method signature.
Preserve the controller's percentage-based downsizing invocation.
Preserve animation and aspect-ratio options for emoji resizing.
items.notes: No usable anchor. Local classification reflects that consolidating the model's method can restore compatibility without caller edits. The verified failing caller passes five arguments; four arguments instead bind the numeric height as opts.

items.defectStatement: The downsizing loop keeps using an open Tempfile after processing its pathname. If processing replaces the file's inode, subsequent size checks and the Tempfile passed to Upload.create_for can still reference the original oversized content.
obligations: Refresh the Tempfile's underlying file handle after each downsizing attempt so subsequent checks observe the current file.
Pass the current content, positioned at its beginning, and its current size to Upload.create_for.
Preserve the five-attempt bound, image eligibility checks, percentage reduction, animation option, and Tempfile cleanup.
items.exampleFix:
# allow users to upload large images that will be automatically reduced to allowed size
      if tempfile && tempfile.size > 0 && SiteSetting.max_image_size_kb > 0 && FileHelper.is_image?(filename)
        attempt = 5
        while attempt > 0 && tempfile.size > SiteSetting.max_image_size_kb.kilobytes
          OptimizedImage.downsize(tempfile.path, tempfile.path, "80%", allow_animation: SiteSetting.allow_animated_thumbnails)
          tempfile.open
          attempt -= 1
        end
      end
items.notes: The gold description's infinite-loop claim is incorrect: attempt bounds execution to five iterations. The issue is a stale file descriptor, not cached size. Tempfile#open reopens the pathname without truncation and resets position; rewind alone or changing only the loop's size check is insufficient.
